method: Separate observed outcome, causal attribution, alternatives, costs, and counterfactual; influence scores remain null until net effects established.

cases.observed: CREA September: Russian fossil fuel revenue €625m/day, China largest buyer, India second; buyer concentration persists.
cases.hypothesis: Concentrated buyers could constrain Russian bargaining power, despite sustained revenue.
cases.missing: Price discounts, shipping costs, alternative suppliers, net margins and causal comparison

cases.observed: US Russia-related sanctions waiver October 2026; India-US trade negotiations ongoing.
cases.hypothesis: India may retain energy purchasing flexibility.
cases.missing: Final tariff terms, landed prices, refinery cost savings and credible no-waiver comparison

cases.observed: November US election may alter trade negotiation positions; no completed new trade outcomes measured.
cases.hypothesis: Trading partners may gain bargaining space.
cases.missing: Actual enacted tariffs, delivered investments, trade flows and price effects

cases.observed: EU Russian gas import share 45% in 2021 to 12% in 2025.
cases.hypothesis: EU reduced exposure to Russian gas leverage, with potentially offsetting costs.
cases.missing: Security gains, alternative gas costs, industrial impact and no-diversification counterfactual

rules: No positive or negative influence score inferred solely from signed deals, spending, growth or directional proxies.
Diplomacy is supporting context, not a scored fourth dimension.
validationRetryNote: 2026-11-09: retrigger PR checks after GitHub Actions internal server errors (no jobs started); no research or scoring changes.

russiaCrudeBuyerConcentration.measure: Share of Russian crude exports by importing destination, not all fossil fuel exports or current monthly share
russiaCrudeBuyerConcentration.interpretation: Concentrated demand is observed; buyer bargaining power and Russia net price concession remain unquantified

euRussianGas.interpretation: Lower exposure to Russian gas disruption; greater sensitivity to global LNG market shocks; net benefit/cost and causal counterfactual not quantified

remainingGaps: For Russia, matched monthly destination prices net of freight, insurance and discounts to infer buyer leverage
For EU, quantify 2021-2025 gas import cost, industrial demand destruction, LNG infrastructure costs and reliability benefits with comparable baselines
For India, matched landed crude prices and tariff concessions under waiver versus enforcement
For US-China trade, signed and implemented commitments with delivered volume and cost observations
